checks.name: forgot-password-login-flow
checks.evidence: On /login, filled login-email-input, clicked forgot-password-link -> forgot-password-dialog opened with forgot-password-email-input prefilled with the same email; submit showed forgot-password-sent, no POST /api/auth/login fired (tracked via page.on('request')), no 'Email o password non corretti' toast, URL stayed on /login. Also re-ran once against the public preview URL https://noi-leyni--0yh202aj.preview.emergentagent.com (passed).

checks.criterion: Forgot password API never reveals whether an email exists
checks.name: test_tscheck_forgot_password_no_enum.py
checks.evidence: POST /api/auth/forgot-password: unknown tscheck-nouser-*@example.it -> 200 {ok:true}; existing giulia.rossi@example.it -> 200 {ok:true} (read-only, not modified); {email:'not-an-email'} -> 422. 3 asserts, all passed.

checks.criterion: Reset link sets a new password and logs in
checks.name: test_tscheck_reset_password_token.py
checks.evidence: Created temp tscheck-reset-*@example.it athlete via /auth/register/athlete, inserted a password_tokens row directly in Mongo (sha256 token_hash, used=false, expires in 30min). GET /api/auth/password-token/{token} -> 200 returns the email; POST /api/auth/set-password -> 200 logs in as that user; reusing same token -> 400. Temp user + token cleaned up in fixture teardown.

checks.name: admin-board-add-remove-member
checks.evidence: Logged in as admin@leinivolley.it, admin-tab-board -> board-email-input + board-add-button with tscheck-board-*@example.it created board-member-<email> row; re-submitting same email showed a 409 duplicate error toast ('...usata da un altro account').

checks.criterion: Admin removes a board member; cannot remove self or last admin
checks.name: admin-board-add-remove-member
checks.evidence: Same check: board-member-admin@leinivolley.it (logged-in admin) shows the 'tu' badge and has no board-remove-* button; board-remove-<tscheck email> with confirm dialog removed the freshly-created row (count -> 0). API self-removal cross-checked in test_tscheck_board_admin_only.py::test_admin_cannot_remove_self (DELETE /api/admin/admins/{own id} -> 400).
